legendary_year_old_space_western_officia.headline: Trigun Manuscript

marvel_zombies_dplus_specials_2027.headline: Marvel Zombies Disney+ Specials
marvel_zombies_dplus_specials_2027.summary: Three Marvel Zombies specials are slated for Disney+ beginning in 2027, directed by Bryan Andrews and expanding the MCU zombie storyline.

fool_night_trailer_2026_11_05.headline: Fool Night

stranger_things_prequel_series_alongside.headline: Other Worlds

rainy_day_serenade_2027_ann.headline: Rainy Day Serenade

glen_powell_talks_dc_big_role_that_requi.headline: Glen Powell In Talks With DC For “Big Role”

things_you_need_know_before_avatar_seven.headline: Avatar: Seven Havens Season 2

wolverine_sales_concern_insomniac.headline: Godzilla Premium Agave Spirits Collaboration

solo_leveling_bless_2027_release.headline: Bless

todd_mcfarlane_toys_sale_2026.headline: Hana-Kimi

it_s_been_years_since_vin_diesel_revived.headline: Riddick (2013)

laid_back_camp_s4_trailer_2026.headline: Dragon Ball DAIMA

a_famous_musician_wrote_a_weird_elf_scri.headline: The Edge’s Unproduced Elf 2 Screenplay

green_lantern_corps_preview_krona_anothe.headline: Green Lantern Corps #22
green_lantern_corps_preview_krona_anothe.summary: Green Lantern Corps #22 arrives in stores on November 11, 2026 as the second part of the Green Lantern: First Light storyline.

before_into_the_spider_verse_marvel_s_be.headline: Big Hero 6

tv_years_ago_hbo_s_comic_book_masterpiec.headline: Watchmen (HBO series)

dc_villains_who_can_give_the_flash_a_run.headline: 7 DC Villains Who Can Give the Flash a Run for His Money

dc_u_gunn_departure_2026_11_12.headline: Peacemaker Season 2 cliffhanger future uncertain after James Gunn's departure

highlights: Gunn confirmed his departure from DC Studios, causing uncertainty for DCU storylines
Peacemaker Season 2 ends with John Cena’s hero stranded on an alien planet, intended to tie into a “Salvation Run” adaptation
Fans fear the cliffhanger may never be resolved, despite potential links to the upcoming Man of Tomorrow film slated for Summer 2027
dc_u_gunn_departure_2026_11_12.why_it_matters: The unresolved cliffhanger could affect continuity across the DCU’s expanding film and TV universe.

dc_studios_leadership_change_2026.headline: The Penguin
dc_studios_leadership_change_2026.summary: Colin Farrell says there is “definitely a conversation” about a second season of The Penguin amid DC Studios’ restructuring.
highlights: Farrell expressed interest in returning for a second season during a London interview
The series is part of the DC Studios slate and streams on HBO Max
Matt Reeves recently signed a new TV development deal with Warner Bros. after the Skydance‑Warner merger
dc_studios_leadership_change_2026.why_it_matters: A continuation would extend a hit DC crime drama and could shape the direction of the evolving DC Universe.

arnold_vosloo_confirms_mummy_return_reve.headline: The Mummy: Book of the Dead
arnold_vosloo_confirms_mummy_return_reve.summary: Arnold Vosloo confirms he will reprise Imhotep in the upcoming sequel The Mummy: Book of the Dead, slated for theatrical release on October 15, 2027.
highlights: Imhotep’s actor Arnold Vosloo announced his return on the Danger Close podcast
The film will also see Brendan Fraser, Oded Fehr, Kevin J. O’Connor and Rachel Weisz returning to their roles
The sequel is officially titled The Mummy: Book of the Dead and is scheduled for an October 15, 2027 theatrical release
arnold_vosloo_confirms_mummy_return_reve.why_it_matters: The return of the iconic villain and original cast raises expectations for reviving the classic franchise.

dragonball_super_english_dub_2026.headline: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus English Dub Streams on Crunchyroll
dragonball_super_english_dub_2026.summary: The English dub of the enhanced Dragon Ball Super: Beerus series begins streaming on Crunchyroll on November 12, 2026.
highlights: Sean Schemmel confirmed the English cast is recording new dialogue for the dub
Crunchyroll and Toei Animation announced the dub will launch at 8:00 a.m. PT on November 12
The dub will roll out weekly for North America, Australia, New Zealand, and Latin America
dragonball_super_english_dub_2026.why_it_matters: Fans get a fresh English voice performance for the revamped series rather than recycled audio.

chris_pratt_talks_way_the_warrior_kid_re.headline: Way of the Warrior Kid
chris_pratt_talks_way_the_warrior_kid_re.summary: Chris Pratt stars in Apple TV’s drama film Way of the Warrior Kid, adapted from Jocko Willink’s novel.
highlights: Directed by McG, known for Charlie’s Angels and Terminator Salvation
Pratt plays a recovering Navy SEAL who mentors his bullied nephew
Adapted from the novel by former Navy SEAL Jocko Willink
Streams on Apple TV starting November 25, 2026
chris_pratt_talks_way_the_warrior_kid_re.why_it_matters: The film marks Pratt’s move toward grounded, real‑world hero stories after years of sci‑fi and superhero roles.

robert_englund_officially_starts_shootin.headline: Behind the Mask II: The Return of Leslie Vernon
robert_englund_officially_starts_shootin.summary: Production has begun on the long‑awaited sequel to the cult meta‑slasher film Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon.
highlights: Filming started in Illinois according to an Instagram update by actor Ben Pace
Robert Englund returns, expanding his role from the 2006 original
Original director Scott Glasserman and writer David J. Stieve are back on the project
Terrifier star David Howard Thornton has a key role in the sequel
robert_englund_officially_starts_shootin.why_it_matters: The sequel fulfills two decades of fan demand and could revive interest in the underrated original film.

dcus_star_gunn_safran_exit.headline: Frank Grillo praises James Gunn and Peter Safran after DCU leadership change
dcus_star_gunn_safran_exit.summary: Actor Frank Grillo publicly thanked James Gunn and Peter Safran following reports of their departure from the DCU.
highlights: Grillo posted an Instagram video thanking Gunn and Safran, calling them "two of the most loyal guys"
He highlighted his positive experience working on Superman, Peacemaker, Creature Commandos and upcoming Man of Tomorrow
The comments come amid reported news that Gunn and Safran will leave the DCU next month, sparking mixed reactions among cast and fans
dcus_star_gunn_safran_exit.why_it_matters: The endorsement from a key DCU star underscores the potential impact of the leadership shake‑up on the franchise’s talent and future direction.

spy_x_family_s4_2026.headline: Doctor Doom’s Voice in VisionQuest Finale Sparks Debate
spy_x_family_s4_2026.summary: Fans noticed a different voice for Doctor Doom in the VisionQuest post‑credits scene and are debating whether Robert Downey Jr.
highlights: The post‑credits scene shows Doctor Doom resurrecting Wanda Maximoff on Disney+
Viewers claim the voice sounds unlike Robert Downey Jr.’s previous performances
Speculation includes possible voice modulation or a different actor such as Cillian Murphy
No official confirmation has been given by Marvel Studios
spy_x_family_s4_2026.why_it_matters: The voice portrayal could affect expectations for Doctor Doom’s role in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday.

ray_gunn_trailer_nov2026.headline: Ray Gunn
ray_gunn_trailer_nov2026.summary: Netflix released a new trailer for Brad Bird’s animated sci‑fi adventure Ray Gunn, showcasing more of the retro‑futuristic city of Metropia.
highlights: The trailer reveals Metropia’s skyline, flying cars and Art Deco skyscrapers
Sam Rockwell and Scarlett Johansson return as leads, with Tom Waits voicing the alien partner
Michael Giacchino returns to score the film, continuing his collaborations with Bird
ray_gunn_trailer_nov2026.why_it_matters: The film marks Brad Bird’s long‑awaited return to original animation and promises a mature, noir‑styled sci‑fi experience on Netflix.

children_blood_and_bone_unveils_paramoun.headline: Children of Blood and Bone
children_blood_and_bone_unveils_paramoun.summary: Paramount released a new trailer for the upcoming fantasy film Children of Blood and Bone, based on Tomi Adeyemi’s 2018 novel.
highlights: The film is directed by Gina Prince‑Bythewood, who also co‑wrote the screenplay with Adeyemi
Stars include Thuso Mbedu, Damson Idris, Amandla Stenberg and an ensemble cast featuring Viola Davis and Idris Elba
The movie is slated to open in theaters on January 15, 2027
The author has publicly distanced herself from the project after a negative on‑set experience
children_blood_and_bone_unveils_paramoun.why_it_matters: It marks a high‑profile live‑action adaptation of a popular YA fantasy series, generating buzz and controversy ahead of its release.

fine_young_cannibals_roland_gift_s_comic.headline: A Punk's Progress
fine_young_cannibals_roland_gift_s_comic.summary: Former Fine Young Cannals singer Roland Gift has adapted his BBC Radio 4 drama into a comic illustrated by Gareth Sleightholme, debuting at Thought Bubble.
highlights: Gift wrote and starred in the BBC Radio 4 drama "A Punk's Progress" in 2022
Artist Gareth Sleightholme of Iron Shot Ape Comics is drawing the comic adaptation
The comic will be sold at Thought Bubble’s 2000 AD Hall, table B32, in Harrogate on 14‑15 November 2026
fine_young_cannibals_roland_gift_s_comic.why_it_matters: It marks a notable crossover of a music icon into the UK indie‑comics scene, highlighting Thought Bubble’s role in showcasing creator‑driven projects.

kakao_piccoma_launches_new_lulumiru_bl_w.headline: Lulumiru BL Webtoon Platform
kakao_piccoma_launches_new_lulumiru_bl_w.summary: Kakao Piccoma has launched Lulumiru, a new BL‑focused webtoon service in Japan.
highlights: The free service is accessible via web browsers on smartphones, tablets and PCs
It offers both new and older BL series with advanced search filters, including a “top‑x‑bottom” pairing tool
Kakao Piccoma is promoting Lulumiru with large‑scale ads in Ikebukuro, Tokyo from November 9‑22
The launch follows Kakao Entertainment’s recent decision to shut down its North American Tapas platform in March 2027
kakao_piccoma_launches_new_lulumiru_bl_w.why_it_matters: Lulumiru expands dedicated BL content in Japan, reflecting growing demand and Kakao’s strategic shift toward consolidating its webtoon offerings.

supporting_pair_shin_oishinbo_manga_anim.headline: Shin Oishinbo
supporting_pair_shin_oishinbo_manga_anim.summary: The television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya's Oishinbo manga, Shin Oishinbo, announced two new supporting voice actors.
highlights: Kenji Yamauchi and Ken Uo were revealed as the voices of Mantarou Kyougoku and Toujin Touyama
Kenichi Nishida is directing the series at SynergySP and Vega Entertainment
The series is slated to premiere in 2027
supporting_pair_shin_oishinbo_manga_anim.why_it_matters: The casting news confirms progress on a highly anticipated revival of the classic culinary series.

fatal_fury_city_the_wolves_game_fatal_fu.headline: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves – Laocorn Gaudeamus DLC
fatal_fury_city_the_wolves_game_fatal_fu.summary: SNK announced that Laocorn Gaudeamus from the 1994 Fatal Fury: The Motion Picture anime will join Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves as a Season Pass 3 DLC character on November 19, 2026.
highlights: Laocorn Gaudeamus will be added as a Season Pass 3 DLC character on November 19, 2026.
The announcement was accompanied by a new trailer and a digest movie of the 1994 anime film.
The game originally launched in April 2025 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S and PC, and reached Nintendo Switch 2 digitally on October 22, 2026.
fatal_fury_city_the_wolves_game_fatal_fu.why_it_matters: The addition brings a classic film character into the roster, appealing to long‑time Fatal Fury fans and expanding the game’s crossover appeal.

anime_frontier_2026_lineup.headline: Crunchyroll Anime Frontier 2026 Premiere Lineup
anime_frontier_2026_lineup.summary: Crunchyroll announced the early‑screening lineup for Anime Frontier 2026, featuring titles such as Dengeki Daisy, BLESS and The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All.
highlights: The convention runs Dec. 4‑6, 2026 at the Fort Worth Convention Center in Texas
Screenings include first episodes of Dengeki Daisy, BLESS, Here U Are and The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn’t a Guy At All
Additional early screenings slated for Fate Rewinder, Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms S2 and Shangri‑La Frontier S3
anime_frontier_2026_lineup.why_it_matters: The lineup gives fans first looks at several upcoming series, shaping hype ahead of their 2027 releases.

star_wars_a_new_hope_rerelease_details_r.headline: Star Wars: A New Hope 50th Anniversary Rerelease
star_wars_a_new_hope_rerelease_details_r.summary: Lucasfilm confirmed the original Star Wars will return to theaters in February 2026 with multiple immersive formats and a new documentary.
highlights: The film will screen in IMAX 70mm, Digital IMAX, 4DX and D-BOX starting February 19
A March 2027 Cosm 12K+ LED dome experience will follow
A new documentary, The Hero Awakens, will debut on May 4
New celebratory logo and orchestrated score by John Williams will accompany the release
star_wars_a_new_hope_rerelease_details_r.why_it_matters: The rerelease offers fans unprecedented ways to experience the iconic film on its 50th anniversary.

avengers_doomsday_doctor_doom_interview.headline: Gwenpool
avengers_doomsday_doctor_doom_interview.summary: Gwenpool debuted in Howard the Duck #1 (2015), marking Marvel’s most beloved fourth‑wall‑breaking heroine’s entry into Earth‑616.
highlights: First appearance in Howard the Duck #1 (2015) written by Christopher Hastings and illustrated by Danilo Beyruth
She originates from a universe where Marvel heroes are fictional comics, giving her a unique meta‑awareness
Initially acted as an anti‑hero, later became a hero and joined the Champions team
Her origin story highlighted Marvel’s tradition of fourth‑wall‑breaking characters like She‑Hulk and Deadpool
avengers_doomsday_doctor_doom_interview.why_it_matters: Gwenpool’s debut expanded Marvel’s meta‑narrative and introduced a character who bridges fan‑knowledge with in‑universe storytelling.

avengers_doomsday_credits_officially_spo.headline: Avengers: Doomsday Writing Credits Confirm Deadpool & Wolverine Appearances
avengers_doomsday_credits_officially_spo.summary: Writers Guild of America credits reveal Ryan Reynolds and Hugh Jackman received ‘Additional Literary Material’ credits on Avengers: Doomsday, confirming their X‑Men characters will appear.
highlights: Stephen McFeely and Michael Waldron are the credited screenwriters for Avengers: Doomsday
Eight additional contributors are listed, including Eric Pearson, Chris McKenna, Erik Sommers, Jeff Loveness, Andrew Lanham, Destin Daniel Cretton, Ryan
Reynolds and Jackman’s ‘Additional Literary Material’ credits effectively confirm Deadpool and Wolverine will be in the film
avengers_doomsday_credits_officially_spo.why_it_matters: The confirmation signals the long‑rumored crossover of Deadpool and Wolverine into the MCU, a major moment for Marvel fans.

baa_humbug_bella_sheephead_eva_elizabeth.headline: Bella Sheephead by Eva Elizabeth
baa_humbug_bella_sheephead_eva_elizabeth.summary: Eva Elizabeth’s adult folk‑horror comic Bella Sheephead makes its debut at Thought Bubble 2026 in Harrogate, England.
highlights: Debuts at Redshirt Hall table D16 during Thought Bubble’s twentieth edition (Nov 14‑15, 2026)
The story blends shapeshifters, vampires, pride and revenge for an adult‑only audience
Created partly during the creator’s MA at Leeds Arts University after a BA in Edinburgh
baa_humbug_bella_sheephead_eva_elizabeth.why_it_matters: The launch spotlights a new independent folk‑horror title at the UK’s largest comic art festival, giving the creator high‑visibility exposure.

animenewsnetwork.com/news/2026-11-12/fat.headline: Laocorn Gaudeamus Joins Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves

star_wars_marvel_crossover_midnight_rele.headline: Star Wars/Marvel: Hope Assembles #1
star_wars_marvel_crossover_midnight_rele.summary: The first issue of the Star Wars/Marvel crossover will debut as a midnight release in comic stores on January 13, 2027.
highlights: Midnight release scheduled for January 13, 2027 at participating comic shops
Written by Kevin Smith and illustrated by David Marquez
Final order cut‑off for retailers is November 23, 2026
Features first on‑page meeting of Marvel heroes with Star Wars characters such as Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader
star_wars_marvel_crossover_midnight_rele.why_it_matters: The event marks the first official crossover between Marvel and Star Wars, celebrating Star Wars’ 50th anniversary and driving foot traffic to local comic retailers.

abs_batman_anim_adapt_2026.headline: Absolute Batman (animated series)
highlights: The series is deep into development with early visual material shown at NYCC
It will be a 2D animation aiming to stay faithful while expanding Bruce Wayne’s world
Creator Scott Snyder says the show will build on the comic’s first arc and serve as a ‘novelization’ of the series
abs_batman_anim_adapt_2026.why_it_matters: Absolute Batman is a high‑profile DC Comics title, and its adaptation signals Skydance’s commitment to leveraging flagship IPs under the new DC Studios structure.

dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.headline: Uncle Zaxlor Sampler
dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.summary: The Uncle Zaxlor Sampler comic is debuting free at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition in Harrogate.
highlights: Uncle Zaxlor Sampler by Leo Healy and Torgo Wells will be available free at Redshirt Hall table D20 at Thought Bubble
The sampler offers an all‑ages preview of the sci‑fi comedy world of Uncle Zaxlor’s Robot Repair Shop
Issues 1 and 2 of the series will also be on sale at the convention
dragonball_daima_france_debut_2026.why_it_matters: It gives fans a hands‑on look at a new small‑press sci‑fi comedy series and supports the creator‑focused spirit of Thought Bubble’s milestone event.

wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.headline: Gatto
wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.summary: Pixar’s upcoming film Gatto features a cat protagonist and a new 2‑D hand‑painted visual style blended with CG.
highlights: Mark Ruffalo voices Nero, a black stray cat in Venice
The film combines 2‑D hand‑painted animation with CG depth
A star‑studded cast includes Laurence Fishburne, John Turturro and Isabella Rossellini
An original short titled “Loving Dory” will accompany the feature
wonder_woman_supergirl_recasting_dcu_sha.why_it_matters: The stylistic shift shows Pixar experimenting beyond its traditional polished CG look, potentially influencing future animation trends.

times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.headline: DC Movie Franchises That Ended Despite Sequel Plans
times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.summary: Several DC film series have been abruptly halted despite having sequels in development, highlighting the franchise’s volatility.
highlights: The Flash (2023) earned $271.4 million on a $220 million budget and its planned sequel was cancelled after poor reception.
Black Adam (2022) grossed $393.5 million against a $260 million budget, leading to the cancellation of Black Adam 2 and related crossovers.
Superman IV (1987) made $36.7 million on a $17 million budget, prompting the abandonment of the planned Superman Reborn sequel.
Batman Returns (1992) performed poorly enough that Tim Burton’s intended third Batman film was shelved, shifting the franchise to Joel Schumacher.
times_dc_movie_franchises_abruptly_ended.why_it_matters: Understanding these cancellations reveals the challenges DC faces in maintaining a cohesive cinematic universe.

azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.headline: Azmodanus Demonic Debut Spinoff
azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.summary: A new Azmodanus comic by Dark Cloud creators Dan Chadwick and Anthony Cook launches at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition.
highlights: The spinoff centers on the devil Azmodanus, first introduced in Dark Cloud #3.
It presents a forced‑therapy story that reveals the secret history of Hell’s Damnation Accords.
The debut occurs at Thought Bubble’s 20th‑anniversary event in Harrogate on November 14‑15.
Creators Dan Chadwick and Anthony Cook are the writers/artists behind the project.
azmodanus_gets_a_demonic_debut_spinoff_d.why_it_matters: It expands the Dark Cloud universe and highlights small‑press creators at a major UK comic festival.

bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.headline: Bonaparte
bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.summary: Luca le Jeune’s adult‑only manga Bonaparte, depicting Napoleon’s return and the lead‑up to Waterloo, debuts at Thought Bubble 2026.
highlights: Debuts at Thought Bubble’s 20th anniversary weekend in Harrogate on 14 November 2026
Published under the Loocart banner and available at Redshirt Hall, table B6b
Inspired by Sergei Bondarchuk’s 1970 epic film Waterloo
Targets adult readers with a historical war narrative
bonaparte_a_waterloo_manga_luca_le_jeune.why_it_matters: Shows the growing prominence of small‑press, creator‑owned manga in Western comic festivals.

keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.headline: Yield
keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.summary: Nicola Streeten’s new graphic novel Yield launches at Thought Bubble’s 20th edition in Harrogate.
highlights: Yield is a full‑colour hardback of 228 pages published by Plowman Press
The story follows John Evarts of Black Mountain College, blending queer history, family memory and archival research
Streeten will present the book at the UK’s largest comic art festival, Thought Bubble, on 14‑15 November 2026
keanu_constantine2_renewed_hope_2026.why_it_matters: The debut spotlights a small‑press work that explores under‑represented queer histories within the comics medium.

dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.headline: Amazing Spider-Man: Power And Responsibility
dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.summary: Marvel announced the first Marvel Brick collection, gathering the early Amazing Spider-Man stories into a 960‑page paperback.
highlights: Collects Amazing Fantasy #15 and Amazing Spider-Man #1‑38 plus the first two annuals
Features first appearances of Spider-Man, Green Goblin, Doctor Octopus and many other classic characters
Will be released July 6, 2027 as a $60 paperback, cheaper than the Epic Collection line
Designed by Tom Muller with a distinctive trade‑dress and “lit‑up” volume indicator
dcu_recast_report_2026_11_13.why_it_matters: The Brick format offers an affordable way to own the foundational Spider‑Man run that’s often out of print.

avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.headline: ComicsPRO names Moni Barrette as new Executive Director
avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.summary: ComicsPRO has appointed Moni Barrette, a veteran librarian and nonprofit leader, as its new Executive Director.
highlights: Barrette brings 20 years of library experience and several years at LibraryPass (now Joyful Reading)
She founded Creators Assemble, a networking nonprofit for comic creators
Barrette replaces outgoing director Marco Davanzo, who stepped down at SDCC
The search emphasized hiring a non‑retailer to focus on industry‑wide relationship building
avengers_doomsday_roster_2026_11_13.why_it_matters: Her extensive industry network and nonprofit expertise aim to strengthen ComicsPRO’s support for comic retailers nationwide.

lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.headline: Furious Redbrow
lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.summary: Dark Horse Comics announced Furious Redbrow, a three‑issue fantasy series by Ben Stenbeck set in the Lands Unknown universe.
highlights: The series follows Redbrow, son of Whitedog, who will become known as the God‑Killer.
It builds on Stenbeck’s 2026 series The Skinless Man and features colors and lettering by Dave Stewart and Clem Robins.
Main cover art by Stenbeck with variant covers by Mike Mignola, Andrea Borgioni and Ben McEntee.
Furious Redbrow #1 is slated for release on March 17, 2027.
lands_unknown_universe_furious_redbrow_m.why_it_matters: It expands Mike Mignola’s Lands Unknown universe, offering fans deeper lore and new characters.

marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.headline: Doctor Doom’s Traumatic Backstory Revealed in Avengers: Doomsday
marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.summary: Marvel confirmed that Doctor Doom has lost a child, adding depth to his motivations in the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday film.
highlights: Empire Magazine confirms Doom is a father who suffered the loss of a child
The VisionQuest post‑credits scene shows Doom confronting Wanda Maximoff to claim her powers
Trailers for Avengers: Doomsday have already hinted at Doom’s vendetta against the Avengers
marvel_doctor_doom_backstory.why_it_matters: The revelation ties Doom’s personal trauma to his antagonistic agenda, enriching the narrative stakes for the film.

j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.headline: J-Novel Club Licenses Seven Light Novels and Six Manga Series
j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.summary: J‑Novel Club announced the addition of seven new light novel series and six manga series to its digital lineup, with two titles slated for print in 2027.
highlights: Seven new light novel licenses were revealed, with eBook releases scheduled throughout February 2027
Six new manga titles are now available digitally, with two slated for print in early 2027
Print releases include Nahuse's Rebuild World (April 27, 2027) and A Royal Rebound: Forget My Ex‑Fiancé, I'm Being Pampered by the Prince! (June 8, 2027)
j_novel_club_licenses_putting_a_price_wo.why_it_matters: The acquisitions expand J‑Novel Club's catalog, offering English‑speaking fans more diverse titles across light novels and manga.

comicsbeat.com/marvel-lays-the-first-bri.headline: What Makes Marvel’s First Brick Collection a Spider‑Man Milestone?

rezero_s5_2026_11_14.headline: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls’ High School Idol Club
rezero_s5_2026_11_14.summary: A new trailer for the Love Live!
highlights: Studio Sublimation is animating the series
Go Kurosaki directs with Haruko Iizuka on character designs and Yoshiaki Fujisawa composing music
The voice cast features newcomers such as Nozomi Nirei and Kokona Nonaka
The series is part of the Link! Like! Love Live! project tied to a 2023 smartphone app
rezero_s5_2026_11_14.why_it_matters: The trailer confirms the continuation of the popular Love Live! franchise with a new idol group and a 2027 debut.

aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.headline: Aquaman
aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.summary: Kakao Entertainment's romance webtoon Aquaman is being adapted into a 10‑episode Japanese live‑action series premiering on December 25, 2026.
highlights: The series is a joint project between Kakao Entertainment and Fuji TV, with production by AOI Pro.
It will debut simultaneously in Japan on Fuji TV’s streaming service and in South Korea on Wavve.
Haru Kashiwagi, Noritaka Hamao and Karen Ōtomo are cast as the main characters.
The original webtoon amassed roughly 200 million cumulative views on Kakao Page.
aquaman_live_action_series_2026_12_25.why_it_matters: It marks a high‑profile Japanese live‑action adaptation of a popular Korean webtoon, expanding its audience across East Asia.

avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.headline: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5
avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.summary: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5 has been officially announced with an ultra‑teaser visual released.
highlights: The fifth season of the series was confirmed by author Tappei Nagatsuki.
An ultra‑teaser visual for Season 5 has been unveiled.
Season 5 will continue the story into the seventh arc, described as even more brutal than the previous arc.
avengers_doomsday_teaser_2026_11_14.why_it_matters: The announcement confirms the continuation of a flagship series beyond its 10th anniversary, keeping fans engaged with new story developments.

gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.headline: Gushing Over Magical Girls Season 2
gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.summary: Season 2 of Gushing Over Magical Girls unveiled a new visual, trailer and a 2027 release date, with Asahi Production returning as studio.
highlights: New visual and trailer confirm a 2027 release date
Asahi Production will animate the sequel, same studio as season 1
All main cast members will reprise their roles
gushing_over_magical_girls_reveals_new_v.why_it_matters: The continuation expands a popular magical‑girl franchise that has a growing international manga readership.

movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.headline: Superman ’78
movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.summary: DC Comics released a sequel miniseries to the 1978 Superman film, continuing its story with Brainiac and Metallo.
highlights: The miniseries follows the film’s continuity, featuring Brainiac shrinking Metropolis and capturing Kryptonian citizens including Jor-El
A follow‑up story, The Metal Curtain, pits Superman against a Soviet‑styled Metallo with a Kryptonite‑powered suit
The comics aim to capture the light‑hearted tone of the original movie, free from its special‑effects limitations
movies_you_probably_didn_t_know_had_comi.why_it_matters: It expands the beloved 1978 film universe for fans seeking new adventures in its classic style.

father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.headline: The Father, The Son, and The Holy Ghost Mine
father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.summary: Tyler Crook and Emily Schnall are launching a three‑issue horror‑western prestige series with Oni Press in February 2027.
highlights: The series follows runaway brothers Buck and Toby as they investigate a Nevada silver mine haunted by ancient horrors.
Each 40‑page issue includes cardstock covers and extensive backmatter such as process art and historical references.
The debut issue releases on February 3, 2027, priced at $6.99 and featuring multiple variant covers.
Creator duo previously collaborated on Tales from Harrow County, bringing their horror expertise to the Old West setting.
father_son_ghost_mine_oni_feb2027.why_it_matters: It blends classic Western mythos with horror, expanding the genre scope of modern indie comics.

rezero_s5_ann.headline: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu
rezero_s5_ann.summary: A fifth season of the Re:Zero anime was announced at the series' 10th Anniversary Starlight Party event.
highlights: The 10th Anniversary Starlight Party special revealed an ultra‑teaser visual for season 5.
The series is produced by White Fox, which handled all previous seasons.

highlights: George Miller was hired in 2007 to direct Justice League: Mortal with a screenplay by Kieran and Michele Mulroney
The film was fully cast, including D.J. Cotrona as Superman and Adam Brody as the Flash, before being cancelled due to the writers’ strike and Australian
Warner Bros. pulled the plug despite the completed screenplay later leaking online
Incoming DC Studios chief Jeremy Latcham has been tasked with assembling the Justice League quickly, prompting speculation that the dormant script could be used
dc_justice_league_script_skydance_2026_1.why_it_matters: Reviving the script could give Skydance a ready-made, ambitious Justice League movie without starting from scratch.

shiboyugi_sequel_production_2026.headline: Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. Sequel Anime
shiboyugi_sequel_production_2026.summary: A sequel to the Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu.
highlights: The sequel was revealed at the MF Bunko J Autumn School Festival 2026 with an "ultra" teaser visual.
Studio Deen will produce the new season, continuing the adaptation of Yuushi Ukai's light novel series.
Crunchyroll will simulcast the upcoming sequel with subtitles and dubs across multiple languages.
shiboyugi_sequel_production_2026.why_it_matters: The continuation expands the story of a popular action‑suspense series and keeps its international audience engaged.

hiden_no_aria_corto_2027_premiere.headline: Female Leads in 2026 Anime Highlighting Industry Shift
hiden_no_aria_corto_2027_premiere.summary: 2026 sees notable anime series featuring female protagonists that challenge the traditionally male‑dominated industry.
highlights: "Smoking Behind the Supermarket With You" centers on Yamada, a dual‑personality female lead balancing everyday realism with a cool alternate persona
"Witch Hat Atelier" follows Coco, a magical‑seinen heroine whose relentless determination mirrors classic shonen spirit
"Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia" showcases Sitara, a slave‑turned political avenger driving a revenge plot against the Mongol Empire
hiden_no_aria_corto_2027_premiere.why_it_matters: These series demonstrate a growing diversity of female leads, signaling broader narrative possibilities in anime.

voice_actor_kiyono_yasuno_announces_marr.headline: Voice Actor Kiyono Yasuno Announces Marriage
voice_actor_kiyono_yasuno_announces_marr.summary: Voice actress Kiyono Yasuno publicly announced her marriage on social media.
highlights: Yasuno shared a statement thanking fans for their support
The post garnered 32,000 likes and over 1,000 congratulatory replies
She is known for roles in Aikatsu!, Saekano, Macross Delta, My Hero Academia, Black Clover and Edens Zero
voice_actor_kiyono_yasuno_announces_marr.why_it_matters: Her marriage news is notable for fans of the many popular series she has voiced.

witch_the_holy_night_film_expands_cuts_s.headline: Witch on the Holy Night Film Expands 981 Cuts for ScreenX Release
witch_the_holy_night_film_expands_cuts_s.summary: The Witch on the Holy Night anime film will debut in premium ScreenX and other formats in Japan on November 27, featuring 981 updated side‑screen cuts.
highlights: ufotable created about 981 updated cuts for the ScreenX side screens, totaling 67 minutes and six seconds
The film will play in ScreenX, Ultra 4DX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, and MX4D across Japan starting Friday, November 27
Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will bring the film to the U.S. and Canada on January 29, 2027 with subtitles and an English dub
witch_the_holy_night_film_expands_cuts_s.why_it_matters: The extensive side‑screen work showcases ufotable’s commitment to immersive cinema experiences for anime fans.

vault_comics_full_february_solicits_agen.headline: Agents Arcana
vault_comics_full_february_solicits_agen.summary: Vault Comics' February 2027 solicitations introduce Agents Arcana, a tarot‑themed super‑spy comic by Paul Cornell and Giorgia Sposito.
highlights: Written by Hugo‑nominated Paul Cornell and Giorgia Sposito
Features tarot houses as immortal criminal networks
First issue priced at $3.99 and slated for release on 2/3/2027
vault_comics_full_february_solicits_agen.why_it_matters: The series blends mystic espionage with a unique tarot‑based worldbuilding, marking a high‑profile creator team for Vault Comics.

sh_zen_tv_anime_unveils_new_key_visual_m.headline: Shōzen
sh_zen_tv_anime_unveils_new_key_visual_m.summary: The Shōzen TV anime revealed its first trailer, key visual, and additional cast details.
highlights: Kana Hanazawa joins the cast as Ko Kuka
Directed by Itsurō Kawasaki with scripts at Dangan Pictures and Cannon Code
Series will premiere on Fuji TV’s B8station block in April 2027
Music composed by Takurō Iga
sh_zen_tv_anime_unveils_new_key_visual_m.why_it_matters: The adaptation brings Jiang Jia Meizi’s Chinese manhua to a mainstream Japanese TV slot, expanding its international reach.

avengers_doomsday_trailer_spoil.headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Release Date Leak
avengers_doomsday_trailer_spoil.summary: Actress Haley Atwell hinted that a new trailer for Avengers: Doomsday will drop on Monday, sparking fan excitement.
highlights: Haley Atwell said a new Avengers: Doomsday trailer will be released on Monday
Fans are speculating the trailer could debut during Monday Night Football
Previous Avengers trailers typically arrived about a month before the film’s release
avengers_doomsday_trailer_spoil.why_it_matters: The early trailer could shape fan expectations and marketing momentum ahead of the film’s debut.

new_mashle_live_action_movie_reveals_bes.headline: Mashle: Magic and Muscles Live-Action Movie
new_mashle_live_action_movie_reveals_bes.summary: The live-action adaptation of Mashle: Magic and Muscles is set to premiere in Japanese theatres on March 19, 2027.
highlights: Mackenyu has been revealed as the actor portraying Mash Burndead
The film is overseen by Warner Bros. and Fuji TV, produced by CREDEUS, and distributed by TOHO in Japan
It will debut in Japanese theatres on March 19, 2027, with international release dates yet to be announced
new_mashle_live_action_movie_reveals_bes.why_it_matters: It marks the franchise’s first major live-action film, expanding Mashle’s reach beyond anime and manga fans.

demon_slayer_movie_trailer_witch_holy_ni.headline: Witch on the Holy Night
demon_slayer_movie_trailer_witch_holy_ni.summary: Ufotable’s new TYPE‑MOON prequel film Witch on the Holy Night debuted in Japanese theaters and will arrive in North America on Jan 29, 2027.
highlights: The film premiered in Japan this past weekend and is being shown in Screen X and other premium formats.
A new trailer and poster were released to promote the theatrical run.
Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will distribute the movie in the U.S., Canada and other territories on Jan 29, 2027 with both Japanese and English
Directed by Masashi Takeuchi with character designs by Moe Tsuzuki and music by Hideyuki Fukasawa.
demon_slayer_movie_trailer_witch_holy_ni.why_it_matters: It marks Ufotable’s next major release between Demon Slayer projects and expands the Fate‑related universe for new and existing fans.

avengers_doomsday_trailer_xmen_2026.headline: Avengers: Doomsday Trailer Reveals Unexpected X‑Men Lineup
avengers_doomsday_trailer_xmen_2026.summary: The final trailer for Marvel’s Avengers: Doomsday showcases an X‑Men team featuring Cyclops, Mystique, Beast, Nightcrawler and Gambit, while omitting Professor X and Magneto.
highlights: Cyclops is the first X‑Man shown, fighting alongside Sam Wilson
The trailer confirms the return of Mystique, Beast, Nightcrawler and Channing Tatum’s Gambit
Professor X and Magneto are absent, hinting they may be killed off early
The X‑Men appear alongside Thor, Mr. Fantastic, Shang‑Chi and other MCU heroes
avengers_doomsday_trailer_xmen_2026.why_it_matters: The lineup defies expectations and suggests major plot shifts for the X‑Men in the MCU

avengers_doomsday_trailer_2026_11_23.headline: The Marvel Art of Peach Momoko
avengers_doomsday_trailer_2026_11_23.summary: Clover Press announced the eleventh volume of its high‑end art‑book series, showcasing Peach Momoko’s watercolor Marvel covers and illustrations.
highlights: Features Momoko’s work from Ultimate X‑Men, Demon Days, Jeff the Land Shark, Spider‑Man and Elektra
The 200+ page coffee‑table book will be 9" × 12" and includes Kickstarter‑only extras such as large print portfolios, posters and a puzzle
Momoko, a two‑time Eisner Best Cover Artist winner, joins the Marvel Art Of series which began in 2023 with titles on David Mack and Alex Maleev
avengers_doomsday_trailer_2026_11_23.why_it_matters: Momoko’s distinctive watercolor style brings a fresh artistic perspective to Marvel’s flagship characters and expands the collectible art‑book market.

mahoutsukai_no_yoru_sequel_2026.headline: Mahoutsukai no Yoru sequel anime
mahoutsukai_no_yoru_sequel_2026.summary: A sequel anime to the Mahoutsukai no Yoru movie has been announced and is now in production.
highlights: The announcement was made via the official X account for the Mahoutsukai no Yoru movie adaptation.
The original film, produced by ufotable, premiered in Japan on November 20 and earned over 526.13 million yen in its first four days.
The visual novel is developed and published by Type‑Moon and serves as a prequel to Shingetsutan Tsukihime within the Nasuverse.
mahoutsukai_no_yoru_sequel_2026.why_it_matters: It expands the Nasuverse on screen, giving fans more animated content from a beloved visual novel franchise.

dark_knights_steel_ii_preview_a_royal_tr.headline: Dark Knights of Steel II #5
dark_knights_steel_ii_preview_a_royal_tr.summary: Dark Knights of Steel II #5 arrives from DC on November 25, 2026, written by Tom Taylor with interior art by Otto Schmidt.
highlights: Written by Tom Taylor with interior art by Otto Schmidt
Features a royal tragedy in the kingdom of El and Victor Falcone’s emergence
General Amanda Waller’s machinations are shown as thwarted
Published by DC Comics with multiple cover variants
dark_knights_steel_ii_preview_a_royal_tr.why_it_matters: The issue continues the alternate‑universe Batman saga, advancing key plot twists for fans of the series.

jimoto_no_ijimekko_tachi_anime_cast.headline: Jimoto no Ijimekko-tachi ni Shikaeshi Shiyō to Shitara
jimoto_no_ijimekko_tachi_anime_cast.summary: A promotional video for the upcoming TV anime revealed its main four cast members.
highlights: Kaori Maeda voices wrestling prodigy Akira Mikazuki
Yūko Natsuyoshi voices basketball prodigy Kanae Oborozuki
Lynn voices gaming master Shigure Mangetsu
Rikuya Yasuda voices protagonist Kotarō Hinode
jimoto_no_ijimekko_tachi_anime_cast.why_it_matters: The casting defines the tone for this new romantic‑comedy series and builds anticipation for its 2027 debut.

NYCC: Marvel Announces Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover
New York Comic Con Announcement: Marvel Announces Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover, Crisis Of Faith For 2027
Article Summary
- Marvel announced the Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover, Crisis Of Faith, launching in April 2027.
- Joe Kelly and Bryan Edward Hill will co-write the Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover event.
- Peter Parker’s crisis deepens after Hellgate, as Miles Morales challenges the choices Spider-Man has been making.
- Revealed at New York Comic Con’s Spider-Man panel, Crisis Of Faith promises a no holds barred Spider-Man clash.
Just announced at the Spider-Man panel at New York Comic Con, a Miles Morales/Peter Parker Spider-Man Crossover for April next year, Crisis Of Faith. A "no holds barred" event that sees Peter Peter get swallowed by the self-confidence issues that have hit him since Hellgate came to town, and Miles Morales is not happy about the choices he has been making. NYCC: Marvel X Kadokawa Manga: Venom: Lethal Protector by Peperon
New York Comic Con Announcement: Marvel X Kadokawa Manga: Venom: Lethal Protector by Peperon goes live
Article Summary
- Marvel x Kadokawa launches Venom: Lethal Protector by Peperon on KadoComi, revealed during New York Comic Con.
- The Venom manga follows Eddie Brock in a church, closely echoing the classic comic origin of the symbiote antihero.
- Peperon’s Manga: Venom: Lethal Protector centers on Brock and the symbiote’s shared hatred of Spider-Man.
- Venom joins Deadpool, Iron Man, Spider-Gwen, and Spider-Man in Marvel and Kadokawa’s new manga lineup.
Newly announced today at New York Comic Con, is that Venom is joining Marvel Comics and Japanese publisher Kadokawa on their new Marvel X Kadokawa collaboration with five manga titles on the KadoComi digital platform. The five launched titles are Deadpool, Iron Man, Spider-Gwen, Spider-Man, and Venom, mixing original Japanese-set stories with manga adaptations of classic Marvel storylines. The partnership, announced at San Dieg Marvel and Kadokawa announced the manga Venom: Lethal Protector by Peperon on the KadoComi digital platform at New York Comic Con 2026. The movie is the first theatrical feature in The Apothecary Diaries franchise and features a new mystery written by original series creator. Norihiro Naganuma directs, with TOHO Animation STUDIO handling animation production. Crunchyroll recently announced the acquisition of the North American and worldwide distribution rights for the film.

The curtains rise on a new mystery surrounding a secret treasure hidden in a city on the water.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Episode 1 is now streaming worldwide on multiple platforms, with Crunchyroll and Hulu offering same-day access in the U.S. However, in a bit of déjà vu, the highly anticipated premiere caused serious technical issues for North American Crunchyroll subscribers and the French anime streaming platform Animation Digital Network (ADN). As Anime Updates (@animeupdates) reported on X (formerly Twitter), many Crunchyroll users saw a technical difficulty message when trying to watch Episode 1 immediately after its release. ADN also acknowledged server issues, stating, "We're experiencing difficulties with our server; our teams have been notified. Sorry for the inconvenience."
This is hardly a new phenomenon for Dragon Ball. The Rookie Season 9 Premiere Date Announced The Rookie has been keeping fans on the edge of their seats since Season 8 ended on a shocking cliffhanger in May. Months after the finale, the Season 9 premiere date has finally been announced.
ABC has announced at New York Comic-Con that its hit procedural will officially return for its ninth season on Wednesday, Jan. 6, 2027. The Disney-owned network renewed The Rookie for Season 9 in April, just a month before the Season 8 finale. News of the premiere date comes five months after the eighth season ended on a cliffhanger that no fans saw coming.
The Rookie’s Season 9 Premiere Date Continues a Trend
ABC confirmed over the summer that The Rookie would be held for midseason 2027. This marks the third time the Nathan Fillion-led drama wouldn’t be coming back in the fall. Beginning with Season 7 in 2024, The Rookie has been premiering its seasons in January. The 18-episode seasons have aired consecutively, meaning there haven’t been any breaks, or, if necessary, a break no longer than a week or two.
This will be the fifth time that The Rookie has premiered during midseason. The first was for Season 3 in 2021 following COVID. Darkhold Destiny Wizards of the Coast has released more information regarding the newest Marvel set, Darkhold Destiny, including a first look at some of the cards in the set, as well as the announcement of the writing team for the tie in comic. During the “Bullpen Bulletins! with Stephen Wacker” panel at New York Comic Con, WotC and Marvel teamed up to announce the third Universes Beyond set inspired by the comics, focused on the magical side of the Marvel Universe. This new set features characters that have not been previously depicted in Magic, including a brand new character created for the narrative. Wizards also announced a number of Darkhold Destiny products for every kind of player.
From the Collector Booster Box packaging, we can see that the Time Stone will be the headliner card for the set. Each previous Marvel set has featured a different Infinity Stone, with Spider-Man including the Soul Stone and Marvel Super Heroes including the Mind Stone.
The revealed Darkhold Destiny cards feature a few of the characters and locations present in the story. Michael E. Uslan, Steven S. DeKnight & Sebastián Cabrol Revive Dr Syn
Michael E. Uslan, Steven S. DeKnight and Sebastián Cabrol resurrect Dr Syn in comics for Oni Press in 2027
Oni Press has announced Dr. Syn, a four-issue comic book miniseries that reintroduces Russell Thorndike's early 20th-century proto-pulp vigilante to modern readers. Co-written by Michael E. Uslan, executive producer of the Batman films, and Steven S. DeKnight of Daredevil, with art by Sebastián Cabrol of EC's Catacomb of Torment), the series is set to debut with issue #1 in January 2027.
Originally introduced in Thorndike's 1915 novel Doctor Syn: A Tale of the Romney Marsh, Reverend Doctor Christopher Syn waged a guerrilla campaign against King George III as the Scarecrow of Romney Marsh after the deaths of his family. Previous adaptations included stage plays, films, and Disney's 1963 television serial starring Patrick McGoohan, which also spawned a Gold Key comic. Oni describes this new version as the character's first major appearance in the 21st century and the first time the British figure has been brought to American shores.

Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix (Hi no Tori) – Future Arc Stage Play News
Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix Manga's Future Arc Gets Stage Play in February
posted on  by Alex Mateo
Osamu Tezuka's Phoenix (Hi no Tori) manga is inspiring another stage play that will run at Sakura Hall in Shibuya Cultural Centre Owada in Tokyo from February 6-8. The play Hi no Tori Mirai-hen ZEROMDISTANCE (Phoenix Future Arc ZEROMDISTANCE) adapts the manga's "Future" arc.
The play stars Jutta Yuki as Masato, Narumi Yasuda as the voice of the Phoenix, Moro Morooka as Dr. Saruta, Adone Kudō and Shiina Yuzuki as Tamami, and Kaiki Ohara as Rock.
Ryusei Kudoh is directing and writing the play. He is also serving as executive producer. Ryo Oguri is producing. Nao'ymt is handling the music.
Tezuka wrote Phoenix's "Future" arc between December 1967 and September 1968. The official Osamu Tezuka website describes the second part:
Set in A.D. 3404, the earth is dying, and human beings inhabit a city-state built deep under the ground. The authorities search for Yamanobe Masato, Class 2 space warrior of Megalopolis Yamato. The episode was the third of the season, titled “Faith, Hope & Trick,” and as is evident from the title, this was the episode that […] The third‑season episode “Faith, Hope & Trick” introduced Faith Lehane, reshaping the Slayer mythology and influencing the series’ finale. Faith Lehane, played by Eliza Dushku, debuts as a second active Slayer in episode 3 of season 3 The episode reveals that a Slayer’s death triggers the next Slayer, ending Buffy’s status as the sole Slayer Faith’s arc—from ally to antagonist to key player in the final season—becomes central to the series’ climax against the First Evil

publication_fingerprints.headline: Yumene Connect
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Yumene Connect Ko Sawada’s manga, Yumene Connect, is getting an anime adaptation. A teaser visual and trailer were also released along with the main staff and cast. Studio Massket is animating the series.
Yu Sasahara and Yusuke Kobayashi star in the series as Nano and Yuhi Takamiya, respectively. Sota Yokote is directing with Gigaemon Ichikawa on the script and series composition. Yoshihiro Watanabe is the character designer and Hayato Matsumura is the music composer.
The manga began serialization in Kodansha’s Weekly Shonen Magazine in September 2024. It currently has nine volumes in circulation and the 10th volume is slated to release on October 16, 2026. 
The story follows Yuhi Takamiya, a first-year high school student who misses his entire first week of school because of a sudden illness and worries he won’t make any friends. After hearing his plight, an alien named Nano arrives to help him. Nano eventually moves in with Yuhi, along with another alien lifeform named Nyoru Puppu Panpippi.
Source: Official Website, X (formerly Twitter)
© Ko Sawada, Kodansha / “Yumene Connect” Production Committee

The issue re‑centers Lex Luthor’s upbringing in Shelby, Kansas, altering his canonical origin. Letitia Luthor is retconned as the true founder of LexCorp and the orchestrator of the family’s fake deaths. Previous retcons involving Lionel Luthor’s ties to Vandal Savage are overwritten by the new narrative. Print

Two years later, Attack on Titan: The Musical has announced its first-ever "world tour," giving millions of new AoT fans a chance to see Eren Yeager's epic story brought to life on stage.
The cast of Attack on Titan: The Musical is scheduled for a new round of performances in several countries next year. From April 15-May 2, 2027, the tour will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore. To promote it, the production team released a new key visual featuring a member of the Scout Regiment performing the group's famous salute. Readers can check it out below, along with a trailer.
After Its U.S. Debut, Attack on Titan: The Musical Announces Its First World Tour
With dramatic stage effects, dynamic lighting and grandiose dance sequences, Attack on Titan: The Musical daringly reinterprets Isayama's iconic dark fantasy saga. Reacher With the debut of its latest season and the first spinoff, Neagley, 2026 is a great year for the world of Reacher. As is typical since its debut, the next season went into production as new episodes debuted. However, in a stunning show of faith, the streamer renewed the show for a sixth season before the fifth even completed filming.
The hulking hero Lee Child created is only growing in popularity off-screen, too. Andrew Child's 30th novel in the series hit bookshelves in October, with another on the way. Meanwhile, Frances Neagley will get her first standalone novel, Zero Margin, in 2027, co-written by Yasmin Angoe and Lee Child. Just shy of 30 years after the first book debuted, the character has never been more popular and is on his way to becoming a genuine cultural institution.
In 2026, Reacher Became A Bona Fide Franchise For Prime Video
One week after the Reacher Season 4 finale dropped, Prime Video released the full first season of Neagley starring Maria Sten. This is how the streamer introduced the flagship series in 2022. Only in the second season did it switch to weekly releases. AD Police Files 4K Ultra HD & Blu‑ray Set One of the best entries in the original Bubblegum Crisis saga is returning in just a few months as an upgraded version that old-school cyberpunk sci-fi fans won't want to miss.
As its official Amazon Prime page shows, the highly anticipated 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray release of AD Police Files is coming much sooner than fans expected. The AD Police Files 4K Ultra HD and Blu-ray set will be available on Jan. 12, 2027, leaving fans less than three months to wait before they can bring the upgraded cyberpunk action home.
Bubblegum Crisis' First Spinoff Returns in 4K With January Release Date
Animated by Artmic and AIC, AD Police Files premiered in 1990 as the first spinoff of the hit Bubblegum Crisis anime series. The three-part prequel takes place five years before the events of Bubblegum Crisis and largely follows the early days of Advanced Police inspector Leon McNichol's career.
AD Police Files picks up with McNichol in the midst of a battle against a raging Boomer, the franchise's humanoid androids. Arc System Works Opens New Studio Takumi Arc System Works announced on Thursday it will open Arc System Works Tokyo Studio "Takumi," its new development studio, on November 2. The company stated that it has decided to open a new studio to dramatically strengthen development capabilities across the company, beginning with a new fighting game that has been selected for the "IP360" subsidy project of Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI).
The company added that the new studio is a "strategic cornerstone for going beyond existing conventional game development frameworks and delivering an overwhelming sense of 'ultimate excitement' to players around the world." Additionally, the company envisions the studio as a collaboration hub with a widespread global reach. The company also announced that it is expanding its recruitment of creators with the opening of the new studio.
Arc System Works also recently released the Donutalgame on PC via Steam on September 3 (September 4 in Japan).
Arc System Works also announced on October 10 the PlayStation 5 release for its Blazblue: CentralFiction fighting game.

Kaiju Decode: The Ring of Aidara The project's theme is "a story about kaiju and girls," and the studios are aiming the project at a worldwide audience.
A full anime short for Kaiju Decodestreamed in December 2021 on the Tsuburaya Imagination website. The companies also released a VR anime short titled Kaiju Decode: First Contact on the same day for Oculus Quest. Both anime are listed as the "first part" of the overall project.
The producers for the project include Kōichi Noguchi and Masahiro Onda. Noguchi is the producer of such anime as Expelled from Paradise and KADO - The Right Answer, while Onda is a veteran Tsuburaya Productions producer for such projects as Ultraman Zero: The Revenge of Belial, as well as an executive producer on the SSSS.Gridman anime series. Sei Nakashima is the character designer.

Kanon, Air, Clannad, Heaven Burns Red's Jun Maeda in Palliative Care for Pharyngeal Cancer
posted on  by Rafael Antonio Pineda
Visual Arts/Key announced on Monday that writer and composer Jun Maeda (Kanon, Air, Clannad, Angel Beats!) has been diagnosed with pharyngeal cancer, and has chosen to focus on palliative care, after considering his condition and the outlook for possible treatment.
The announcement also included an e-mail and mailing address for fans to send Maeda a message or letter of encouragement. The staff will accept letters only, and asked fans to refrain from sending gifts or other get-well items. The staff added Maeda is currently hospitalized, but "remains strongly determined to devote himself to creative work through to the very end."
The announcement stated that Maeda has finished work for the first six chapters of the Heaven Burns Red game, including all the major story elements that will take the story to the end of the sixth chapter. He has also completed the lyrics and composition for the songs in the first half of the sixth chapter. Princess Yona lives an ideal life as the only princess of her kingdom. Doted on by her father, the king, and protected by her faithful guard Hak, she cherishes the time spent with the man she loves, Su-won. But everything changes on her 16th birthday when tragedy strikes her family!
Yona reels from the shock of witnessing a loved one's murder and having to fight for her life. With Hak's help, she flees the palace and struggles to survive while evading her enemy's forces. But where will this displaced princess go when all the paths before her are uncertain?
Kusanagi — the creator of Mugen Spiral, Game X Rush, and NG Life — launched the Yona of the Dawn manga in Hakusensha's Hana to Yume magazine in 2009. The manga ended serialization on December 19. The manga had a four-chapter "gaiden" spinoff that ended in Hana to Yume on July 3. The manga's 48th and final compiled book volume shipped on Tuesday. Viz Media released the 46th volume on July 3.
The first Yona of the Dawn television anime by Pierrot premiered in 2014 and aired for 24 episodes. Image courtesy of Seven Seas EntertainmentThe November issue of Shueisha's Ultra Jump magazine published the final chapter of Hikaru Nakamura's Black Night Parade manga on Monday. Nakamura's official X (formerly Twitter) account also posted about the manga ending, and added that it will have a side story and a major announcement in the next issue of Ultra Jump on December 18.
Seven Seas Entertainment publishes the manga in English digitally and in print. The company describes the story:
Hino Miharu will be spending this Christmas just like the last: alone and working a dead-end job. All he wants is good employment, but when he meets a Santa Claus dressed in clothes as black as coal, he has no idea he's encountered the real deal...sort of. publication_fingerprints.headline: Alien (new film)
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Alien (new film) News came earlier this month that Fox was moving forward with a new Alien movie, as one writer spilled the beans about his own involvement. What was unclear at the time, though, was what the next steps for the franchise might be. After the blockbuster success of Alien: Romulus, which became the second highest-grossing movie […] A new Alien movie is in early development, focusing on the android David from the prequel series rather than being a sequel to Alien: Romulus. The project is being written by Aaron Guzikowski, who previously worked with Ridley Scott on the HBO Max series Raised by Wolves. The film will tie into the 2010 prequel sequels Prometheus and Alien: Covenant, using David as the connective element. Michael Fassbender is not formally attached and no director has been announced, indicating the film is still in its early stages.

The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con
The Morning After An Open Bar The Night Before At MCM London Comic Con... from those who made it back at least
On the way to MCM London Comic Con with a heavy head… because last night ReedPOP had an "Industry Mixer" open bar at the Waterfront on the side of London ExCel. And British comic conventions haven't had an open bar for a long time, and the word started to spread amongst comic creators, retailers, publishers and the like, with representatives from DC, Image, Dark Horse, Forbidden Planet, Diamond UK making their way around the building, following the Thames towards the sound of clinking glasses. It's partially David Baillie's fault, who put the word out as he arrived to find himself the only comics person there, and also to be a bit for shouting out at the Diamond UK Retailer meeting held in the Capital Suites of the ExCel that there was an open bar… and here's the TikTok proof.

Here’s how the publisher describes the miniseries that pulls back the curtain on 1950s Hollywood:
Working on Galaxy Pictures’ creature features from inside the famed Leonard family’s special effects house, Mallory Headley creates the masks behind monsters like the Thing from the Muck, Baba Yaga the witch, and Koschei the vampire. The monsters become stars. The Leonards get the credit. Mallory remains largely invisible.
Hollywood knows Mallory Headley’s monsters. It just doesn’t know Mallory Headley.
And Mallory knows something Hollywood doesn’t: the masks are alive.
When the masks are violently taken from her, Mallory sets out to bring them home, beginning a fantastical and brutal path of vengeance through the shadows of 1950s Hollywood.

About My Witch Senpai Misono is an office drone with his own ups and downs at work, but thankfully, he has an ally: his senpai Shizuka, who happens to be a witch. Shizuka is always ready to lend a hand to those in need, but Misono thinks she should take better care of herself, since zipping around on a broomstick to run errands can be quite stressful. Is Misono's over-solicitous concern for Shizuka driven by mere respect for this flustered witch, or could it be more? Let this magical romantic comedy cast its spell on you!

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
One Piece Anime Catalog Fully Available on Crunchyroll India Over 27 years after the anime adaptation officially started airing, the entire One Piece catalog is finally available to stream legally in India, marking a major international expansion.
Crunchyroll is now streaming all 1,180 episodes of the One Piece anime in India, per ANN. The platform added the missing batch from Episodes 326 through 891 on Oct. 25, 2026, covering multiple arcs including the Thriller Bark, Marineford, Fish-Man Island, Dressrosa and Whole Cake Island arcs. With this addition, viewers in India have access to the complete One Piece television anime for the first time since it originally aired in Japan.
Crunchyroll Adds Entire One Piece Anime for the First Time in India
Crunchyroll debuted the One Piece anime in India in September 2023 with the Wano Country arc, adding a total of 186 episodes from 892 through 1077. The episodes were available initially in Japanese with English subtitles, with the English dub sequentially rolling out later that year. Starting with Episode 1078, the streaming service began simulcasting the anime for the first time in the country.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Destiny Unchain Online TV Anime Kou Mitsuki is a gamer with god-tier skills, known online as Crim the Headhunter. Right when he starts testing his father's latest game, Destiny Unchain Online, and the new device developed for it, the bug-ridden system transforms him in into a vampire girl! Everything changes for Kou as he meets new friends and they take on the game... The ultimate gamer adventure awaits!
resn began serializing the original story in the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in May 2020. resn later deleted his profile and subsequently removed the story from the site, but later resumed the story's serialization on Kadokawa's Kakuyomu website in June 2021. Kodansha released the first print volume of the story in November 2022, some months after Yachimoto launched the manga adaptation. Yachimoto also drew the art for the novels. The third volume shipped on May 29.
Yachimotolaunched the manga in Kodansha's Magazine Pocket app in July 2022, and also launched it in Kodansha's Shōnen Magazine R digital magazine beginning in August 2022. After Shōnen Magazine Rceased publication, the manga has only been running on Magazine Pocket. Kodansha released the manga's 13th compiled book volume on August 7.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Wound & Bandage
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Wound & Bandage The new cast includes Yōko Hikasa as Matsu Daemon (far left in above image) and Yuka Iguchi as Magical Penpengusa (far right in above image). The two characters are members of the "bandage alliance" internet community along with the protagonist Riyu Washizu (under the username Wamp Samurai). The "bandage alliance" gathers those who have a fetish of seeing strong people weakened.
The anime will air on ABC and TV Asahi's Animazing!!! programming block, which airs late night on Saturday nights at 26:00 (effectively Sunday mornings at 2:00 a.m.), starting on January 9. The show will first air on AT-X on January 9 at 11:00 p.m. The anime will stream on ABEMA half an hour after the ABC and TV Asahi airing.
The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.
The manga debuted on Kodansha's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.

Kadokawa World Manga English Label Launch News
Kadokawa Launches 'Kadokawa World Manga' English Label on its KadoComi Platform
posted on  by Crystalyn Hodgkins
Kadokawa announced on Friday it has launched the "Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series on its web manga platform KadoComi. The label is available here.
The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences. Kadokawa stated it will add more titles over time to expand the lineup. The company also stated the label is also a publishing platform for "Kadokawa World Manga Atelier," the publisher's initiative "dedicating to discovering and supporting international creators to develop original works."
The launch lineup for the new label includes:
Title: Brain Alive
Author: Rafał Jaki and MACHINE GAMU
Story Summary: An authentic fantasy brought to you by the Executive Producer of the anime "Cyberpunk: Edgerunners" (Season 1)! Daniel, who lost his wife Yui in a car accident, loses consciousness while nursing his comatose son, Hiro, and wanders into another world. Along with Yui's soul, which now resides in his sword, Daniel sets out on an adventure to save Hiro, but...!? The Green Sorceress uses strategies she learns from the unfolding events of WWII to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat in Simon & Kirby's Blue Bolt #7.
Article Summary
- Blue Bolt #7 channels the early WWII crisis into a Simon and Kirby sci-fi clash with striking Golden Age energy.
- The Green Sorceress studies dictatorship tactics on a telescreen and turns blitzkrieg, sabotage, and propaganda against Blue Bolt.
- The Blue Bolt saga in issue #7 captures Joe Simon and Jack Kirby hitting their stride on both story and wartime atmosphere.
- The issue also features wartime tales by Paul Gustavson and Andrew McWhiney, from stolen rail guns to Air Corps bombers.
As with many comics of the early Golden Age, Joe Simon and Jack Kirby's Blue Bolt saga was heavily influenced by the escalating war. In their story in Blue Bolt #7 (December 1940), the Green Sorceress appears to be defeated when she sees Europe's dictators on a telescreen while a captive of Blue Bolt. Cosplayer Enako Sings, Voice-Acts in Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love Anime
posted on 2026-10-31 03:53 EDT by Crystalyn Hodgkins
New promo video previews opening theme
Kadokawa presented the full promotional video for the television anime of Ayune Araragi's Isshiki-san Wants to Know About Love (Isshiki-san wa Koi o Shiritai) manga on Saturday. The video announces that Enako is both singing the anime's opening theme song "Gō Yoku Koi o Seisu!?" and joining the cast as the nurse Nene Haneshita.
The anime will debut in January 2027 and will air on AT-X, Kansai TV, and Tokyo MX. An advanced screening of the first two episodes will be held in Tokyo on December 13.
The romantic comedy follows Isshiki Rinna Milford, an elite, straight-laced officer who joined the police at age 17 (but has not experienced romantic love), and Meishi Rokutanda, a kind but scatterbrained and incompetent detective. As two newbies at love, they become a couple (of sorts) as they find out about romance.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Romelia War Chronicle Anime Seven Seaslicensed the novels' manga adaptation, and it describes the story:
After journeying alongside her fiancé on his quest to defeat the Demon King, Romelia is suddenly deemed useless and sent home, her engagement annulled. While the prince and his group return as celebrated heroes, Rome goes home as a disgrace. But she's not the same girl who left her province. While following the adventurers, Rome was the only one without magic or strength but she found her own abilities in trade, negotiation, finances, and gathering information. And now, she plans to use these skills to not only help her family's province, but help the still struggling kingdom. The Demon King may be defeated, but his allies and demons continue to roam.
With only her wits and brilliance, Rome will build an army of her own and keep the kingdom safe—no matter what it takes.
The anime premiered first via streaming in Japan on U-NEXT, Anime Times, and Netflix on October 3 at 9:00 p.m. (8:00 a.m. EDT). The anime then aired on October 5 at 11:30 p.m. (10:30 a.m. EDT) on the Tokyo MX, BS11, Sun TV, and KBS Kyoto channels. The anime will run for two cours (quarters of a year). Daredevil's Batman-Inspired Debut, Silver Streak Comics #6 at Auction
The debut of the Golden Age Daredevil in Silver Streak Comics #6 borrows elements from Batman stories in Detective Comics #38, #33 and #27.
Silver Streak Comics is a rarity among Golden Age titles in that it was launched with a villain as the cover feature. That villain, The Claw, was both an obvious example of war-era propaganda and based on a blatant racial stereotype. Publisher Lev Gleason was so intent on focusing on this wartime enemies theme that The Claw was cover-featured for the first two issues of the title, with the character meeting with Adolf Hitler in issue #2 and offering to team up with him to conquer the world and split it between them. The title's namesake, the dead-then-resurrected superhero flying speedster character Silver Streak, who himself was named after the futuristic race car in which he was killed, didn't show up until issue #3. publication_fingerprints.headline: Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Ben Wang in talks to play MCU’s Iceman Deadline reports Ben Wang (Karate Kid: Legends, American Born Chinese) is in talks to play Bobby Drake/Iceman in the MCU’s X-Men reboot. Wang, 29, purportedly beat out Gabriel LaBelle (The Fabelmans), Jackson Kelly (The Body), and Rhenzy Feliz (The Penguin) for the part of the X-Men’s frosty longtime member in the film, which is being directed by Jake Schreier (Thunderbolts*) for a release in 2028.
Wang, who is a Chinese-born American, would become the second actor to play Iceman on film, following Shawn Ashmore (who portrayed him in the 2000-06 trilogy, and 2014’s Days of Future Past), and the first Asian version of the character. At the time of writing, the only other person of color who’s been cast in the film is Maya Boyd, who will play Ororo Munroe/Storm.
Since Ashmore played the part, the character of Iceman was revealed to be gay in the comics. Whether this will be the case in the movie remains to be seen, but it would add some further diversity to its onscreen cast; however, it should be noted that Kit Connor and Inde Navarrete, who are respectively playing Scott Summers/Cyclops and Anna Marie/Rogue, are both bisexual.

publication_fingerprints.event_text:
X-Men (2028) Casting Updates X-Men is rounding up Charles Xavier’s students. While Cyclops, Jean, Angel, Storm, and Rogue have been cast, certain characters still have people in the running to play them. One such character is Iceman, aka Bobby Drake, one of the original members of the X-Men. Reportedly, Ben Wang is currently in talks to play the character.
As reported by Deadline, Gabriel LaBelle, Jackson Kelly, and Rhenzy Feliz have tested for the part as well, but Wang seems to be the most likely actor to play the role. Yet, what has caught fans off guard is Wang’s age. While there were some who weren’t so sure about his looks, his being 29 has given a few fans pause for thought. Many believe that while he might look younger than his age now, it may pose a problem later.
However, given that the actor has scores of projects like the upcoming The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping under his belt, he remains a strong pick for the character, age notwithstanding.
Who else is starring in the X-Men movie with Ben Wang?

ThunderCats: Lynxana Dynamite has revealed blind bagged copies of the ThunderCats relaunch will include a new comic this week: ThunderCats: Lynxana, a one-shot by writer Nate Cosby (Cheetara: Worldbreaker) and artist Sebastián Píriz (Johnny Quest), starring Lynxana the bounty hunter. Lynxana never appeared on the original TV show, but was introduced in the fourth issue of the Marvel Comics series (created by David Michelinie, Jim Mooney, and Brett Breeding) in 1986.
Cosby outlined the premise, saying, “We snuck a western into the ThunderCats universe. A distress call gets sent out from a shady planet that’s home to the roughest bounty hunters in all the galaxy. Bluegrass (of SilverHawks) goes to answer the call, but gets shot down before he can even begin to investigate. What, and WHO, he finds on that planet, is gonna impact the ThunderCats comics franchise for years to come.”
The comic will set up a follow-up arriving in February 2027, that will in turn lead to Lynxana “crash[ing]” into the main series by Greg Pak and David Cousens, and the Cheetara comic by Saladin Ahmed and Andrea Arcari. Copies will feature further variations of the cover by Píriz, including printings in black-and-white, without t Dynamite will include the new one-shot ThunderCats: Lynxana in blind‑bag copies of its ThunderCats relaunch this week. publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Reincarnation in the Game World Dan-Katsu The story centers on a gamer with the player name Zephyrus, who has played the legendary dungeon-crawl game Dungeon Shūkatsu no Susume (Encouragement for Job Hunting in Dungeons or Dan-katsu for short) for over 8,000 hours, but he suddenly loses all his save data and dies of shock. When Zephyrus wakes up, he realizes that he is reincarnated in the unconquered world of the Dan-katsu game. He immediately gets the classic strongest job as a hero, and starts "a new game" in the world of Dan-katsu.
Nishikigi launched the story on the Kakuyomu website in January 2021. TO Books started publishing the novels with illustration by Shuri in March 2022. The novels' 16th volume shipped on August 15.
Hiroshi Asagilaunched the novels' manga adaptation on TO Books' Corona EX manga website in April 2022. TO Books published the manga's first compiled book volume in September 2022, and the fifth volume in October 2025.

Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 The wait has been particularly painful for new episodes of Netflix's acclaimed animated series Blue Eye Samurai. It has officially reached the three-year mark since the first season's debut, and in honor of the occasion, Netflix has finally announced when Season 2 will premiere.
Blue Eye Samurai Season 1 debuted on Netflix on Nov. 3, 2026. Three years to the day later, a new teaser trailer was released for the upcoming second season by Netflix. It reveals that Season 2 will launch on Jan. 19, 2027. This follows the announcement made in August that the series had been given an early renewal for a third and final season, which is planned to premiere in 2028. Check out the new teaser below.
Blue Eye Samurai Season 2 Gets a New Teaser Trailer
Maya Erskine returns as the voice of Mizu, who continues her search for her father in London. Six new episodes in the second season will be putting her in an entirely different location, giving it a different feel in some ways compared to Season 1. Of course, fans can also expect Mizu to spill just as much blood as her journey progresses.

Pokémon Pokopia Game Adds Expansion Pass DLC Part 2 'Dazzling Decorations' on December 9
posted on 2026-11-04 12:30 EST by Alex Mateo
The official X/Twitter account for the Pokémonfranchise announced on Wednesday that the second part of the paid Expansion Pass DLC for Pokémon Pokopia, its cozy-style life simulation crafting game for the Pokémonfranchise, will launch on December 9.
The second DLC part includes accessories such as sunglasses, Sylveon ribbon, and bow tie. The DLC will also include Doduo, Skitty, Braixen, and more Pokémon.
The game's paid Expansion Pass DLC added the underwater Bubbly Basin town on August 5 as part 1 of the pass, and it will add another town in 2027 as part 3. Spirit Circle TV Anime Adaptation Satoshi Mizukami’s Spirit Circle manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation, with the release date set for December 2026. A teaser visual and first promotional video were revealed alongside the announcement.
The anime will run for 18 episodes and follows Fuuta Okeya, a 14-year-old boy who can see ghosts, and transfer student Kouko Ishigami. After Kouko notices the strange mark hidden beneath the bandage on Fuuta’s cheek, she reveals that the two are connected through multiple past lives and begins targeting him over a grudge carried across reincarnations.
The announced cast includes:
- Kazuki Ura as Fuuta Okeya
- Anna Nagase as Kouko Ishigami
- Eri Yukimura as Rune
- Yuichi Nakamura as East
Anna Nagase also performs the ending theme, “Koko ga Donna Sekai demo,” marking her first solo vocal performance.
Tatsuo Sato serves as director and series composer, with Kentaro Mizuno as assistant director and Satoru Fujimoto handling character design. NAGOMI and EOTA are co-producing the animation, with TWIN ENGINE producing the series.
Sato, known for works including Martian Successor Nadesico, Bodacious Space Pirates, and Stellvia, passed away in April 2026.
