Trigun Manuscript Trigun is officially making another comeback this winter, and fans couldn't be happier to see their favorite anime Western return once more.
A new novel titled Trigun Manuscript was recently announced in the autumn issue of Sheisha's Jump SQ. Rise magazine, per ANN. Trigun Manuscript is co-written by original franchise creator Yasuhiro Nightow and Trigun Stampede scribe Takehiko Oxi, and will reportedly take place in the same timeline as Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargaze.
Trigun Creator Yasuhiro Nightow Returns for New Release Set in the Stampede and Stargaze Timeline
Although no plot synopsis has been made available for Trigun Manuscript as of writing, the official Trigun anime social media accounts describe the upcoming title as "The long-awaited novelization." As such, fans are expecting that Trigun Manuscript will revisit many of the events of Trigun Stampede and Trigun Stargazer, albeit with new insight and potentially entirely new sequences that were absent from both its predecessors.
Produced by studio Orange, Trigun Stampeded premiered in 2023 as the second anime adaptation of Yasuhiro Nightow's original manga. Laid-Back Camp Season 4 News
Laid-Back Camp Season 4's Trailer Unveils April 2027 Debut
posted on  by Egan Loo
The official website for the television anime of Afro's Laid-Back Camp manga presented the main trailer and main visual for the anime's fourth season on Friday. The trailer and visual announce the season's April 2027 premiere , and the trailer also previews the theme songs.
The trailer features artist Asaka's opening theme song "Brand New.," artist Eri Sasaki's ending theme song "Happa no Tegami" (Leaf Letter), and the band Kiminone's overall series theme song "Tonari ni Ireba."
The website lists the following additional staff members:
- Cooking Design: Kōichi Motomura
- Prop Design: Masateru Inada
- Color Key Artist: Nanako Okazaki
- Art Director: Masatoshi Muto
- Background Art: Studio Jack
- Compositing Director of Photography: Yūta Katayama
- CG Director: Kazuto Furuya
- Offline Editing: Akinori Mishima (Mishima Editing Room)
- Music Produciton: MFIVE
- Sound Production: HALF H·P STUDIO
- Animation Producer: Sōta Machiguchi
The returning cast members include:
- Yumiri Hanamori as Nadeshiko Kagamihara
- Nao Tōyama as Rin Shima
- Sayuri Hara as Chiaki Ōgaki
- Aki Toyosaki as Aoi Inuyama

G.I. Joe (untitled) Paramount is bringing the G.I. Joe franchise back to theaters with a new live-action movie. The upcoming project will feature Bradley Cooper in a leading role, with Danny McBride directing. The film will introduce a fresh take on the long-running Hasbro property, which has struggled to maintain its theatrical success despite its popularity across toys, comics, and animated shows.
The studio has announced that the untitled movie will hit theaters on October 20, 2028. Cooper will portray Duke, a popular member of the G.I. Joe team. McBride is directing and co-writing the screenplay alongside Jeff Fradley and John Carcieri. Lorenzo di Bonaventura, Mark Vahradian, and Zev Foreman are producing the project.
The upcoming installment will offer a fresh take on the franchise instead of continuing the previously discussed G.I. Joe and Transformers crossover. Although the studio has not disclosed the official plot, McBride reportedly revealed on the Happy Sad Confused podcast that it will be centered on Duke and other members of the team. They will be investigating Springfield, a town secretly controlled by Cobra. 'There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her' Anime Gets 2nd Season
posted on 2026-11-07 03:46 EST by Egan Loo
Main cast to reprise roles
The staff for the television anime of Suisei's There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero's Party, So I Tried Confessing to Her (Yūsha Party ni Kawaii Ko ga Itanode, Kokuhaku Shite Mita) light novel series and Kairi's manga adaptation announced on Saturday that production on a second season has been green-lit. The main cast will reprise their roles in the new season.
The story centers on Yōki, a man reincarnated into a fantasy world. Yōki did not reincarnate as a hero or the demon lord, however, but as the demon lord's underling. When a hero's party attacks the demon lord's castle, Yōki is naturally there to fight against the heroes. However, when he sees the priest Cecilia who is part of the hero's party, he falls in love at first sight.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret The official website for the television anime of Kashiko Amane's Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret (Hōkago no Idol ni wa Himitsu ga Aru) manga presented a new teaser promotional video on Saturday. The video announces three more cast members from the idol group ≒JOY, and it also announces and previews the ending theme song "Naritai Watashi" (The Me I Want To Become) by the in-story idol group Indigo Impulse.
Yen Press publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:
Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?!
The anime will premiere in April 2027. Crunchyroll will stream the anime as it airs in Japan.
Amane has been serializing the manga on Hakusensha's Young Animal Web site since September 2022, and Hakusensha published the ninth volume this past July. Sins of Kujo After a debut on Netflix, ABC’s hit crime drama is finally coming back. Season 5 of Will Trent will be premiering in a matter of months.
ABC has released its midseason 2027 schedule, and via The Hollywood Reporter, it reveals that Will Trent is set to return on Tuesday, Jan. 5. Will Trent has been on hiatus since May, and like The Rookie, has been airing exclusively during midseason for the last couple of years. That format is continuing for Season 5, but the wait will surely be worth it.
Will Trent Continues to Be a Hit for ABC
Premiering in 2023, Will Trent was created by Liz Heldens and Daniel Thomsen. It’s based on the series of novels by Karin Slaughter. Ramón Rodriguez stars as the titular Georgia Bureau of Investigation (GBI) Special Agent, who was abandoned at birth and “endured a harsh coming-of-age in Atlanta’s overwhelmed foster care system. Now, Will uses his unique point of view in the pursuit of justice and has the highest clearance rate in the GBI.”
Along with Rodriguez, Will Trent stars Erika Christensen, Iantha Richardson, Jake McLaughlin, Kevin Daniels, and Alexandra Metz. - Daisuke Sakaguchi as Heihachi Okura
- Miyu Tomita as Norl Fanya
- Iori Noguchi as Estelle
Gacha Girls Corps is a light novel series written by Chinkururi with illustrations provided by Yasutaka Isekawa. It was originally launched as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in January 2016. Micro Magazine then published nine volumes in print under their GC Novels imprint from November 2016 to August 2020.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Riddick (2013)
publication_fingerprints.event_text: Riddick (2013) Some science-fiction franchises get bigger with every installment. More planets, bigger battles, and increasingly complicated mythology. That’s usually the plan, anyway. But sometimes a movie becomes more interesting when it stops trying to build an entire universe and remembers what made audiences care in the first place. Vin Diesel learned that lesson the hard way. […] Vin Diesel’s 2013 Riddick film marked a return to the franchise’s survival‑horror roots after the ambitious but divisive The Chronicles of Riddick. The film cost roughly $38 million and was shot in 48 days It restored the series’ R rating and earned about $98 million worldwide Katee Sackhoff and Dave Bautista co‑starred alongside Diesel Theatrical September 2013

publication_fingerprints.headline: Harajuku Himegoto House
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Harajuku Himegoto House The "high-tempo gag" story follows an aspiring hitman who heads to a rumored hideout for assassins in Harajuku, only to discover a cafe staffed by an eclectic group of high-fashion, eccentric individuals.
The project's cast includes:
Yūya Hirose as Mizuki Otokozawa, an aspiring hitman
Tetsuei Sumiya as Mero Togariishi, a high-tension positive "gal"
Sōhei Horikane as Takara Rokurokusō, a foul-mouthed gothic lolita doll
Masaru Yoshimura as Kentarō Jinbayama, a centaur who is the ideal man
Takuma Nagatsuka as Yuki Inubo, a man who wants cure his blue mood
Nobuhiko Okamoto as Hitoshi Haritsukekawara; the twin-tailed, 50-year-old, decora-fashionista store manager
Showtaro Morikubo as Shō Dogenzaka, a flashy men who is 2 trillion yen (about US$12.6 billion) in debt
Plott is responsible for the project's planning and production, Bandai Namco Music Live (Lantis) is providing the project's music, and Animate is collaborating on promotion. Visual artist Aki Akane (also known as Akane Aki) drafted the project's original character illustrations.
The project's first group song will debut on Sunday.

Aoi (Gamers! light novel series) and Tsuzura debuted the manga in Hakusensha's Young Animal Zero magazine in November 2022. The seventh compiled book volume shipped in Japan on August 28.

My Hero Ultra Rumble Game Gets Mobile Version
posted on 2026-11-08 23:59 EST by Rafael Antonio Pineda
English, Japanese teasers streamed
Bandai Namco Entertainment confirmed this month that its My Hero Ultra Rumble (My Hero Academia Ultra Rumble in Japan) battle royale-style action game will have a mobile version. Bandai Namco Entertainment unveiled English and Japanese teaser videos for the game on Monday.
The game centers on eight teams of three players each battling it out in each match. Characters in the game use their Quirks to do battle.
The latest game in the franchise, My Hero Academia: All's Justice, launched worldwide on February 6 (February 5 in Japan) for PlayStation 4, Xbox Series X|S, and PC via Steam.
The My Hero Ultra Impactgameended service on May 18. The game launched for iOS and Android device in February 2022.

Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc (live-action series) The official website for Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc), the new live-action series based on Satoru Noda's Golden Kamuy manga, unveiled two more cast members as well as a new key visual for the series on Monday.
The live-action series will debut streaming on WOWOW on January 24.
The first live-action Golden Kamuy film opened in Japan in January 2024 and topped the Japanese box office in its first weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets for 533,848,690 yen (about US$3.44 million in current conversion) in its first three days. Netflix began streaming the first film in May 2024.
Shigeaki Kubo directed the first film at production company CREDEUS. Tsutomu Kuroiwa wrote the script. Yutaka Yamada composed the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe were credited as Ainu culture advisers.
Kenji Katagiri, Ken Ochiai, and Yōsuke Satō joined the film's director Kubo on directing the follow-up Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- live-action series. Similarly, Yoshiaki Dewa joined the film's composer Yamada for the series. Japanese rock group ACIDMAN performed the theme song "Kagayakerumono" (Those Who Shine). Hinemosu Notari Nikki Shogakukan's Big Comic magazine confirmed on Friday that the eighth compiled book volume of the lateTetsuya Chiba's Hinemosu Notari Nikki manga will be the final volume when it ships on February 12. Shogakukan will also publish Gagyō 70-shūnen Ai to Heiwa to Chiba Tetsuya (70th Anniversary as an Working Artist: Love, Peace, and Tetsuya Chiba), a commemorative book tracing Chiba's 70 years as a manga artist, on February 12.
Chiba launched the Hinemosu Notari Nikki autobiographical short essay manga in Big Comic in December 2015. Shogakukan published the manga's first compiled book volume in 2018, and the seventh volume in November 2025. Chiba put the manga on hiatus on September 25, citing poor health. Chiba died on October 22 due to a myelodysplastic syndrome, a type of cancer that affects the blood cells in the bone marrow.
Chiba debuted as a professional manga creator when he was still in high school at 17 years old in 1956. He is perhaps best known for his Ashita no Joe (Tomorrow's Joe) boxing manga, which ran from 1968 to 1973, and has remained a mainstay in Japanese popular culture for decades. publication_fingerprints.headline: Hirayasumi TV Anime
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Hirayasumi TV Anime With a carefree outlook on life, Hiroto knows better than anyone that slowing down is sometimes the best way to move forward.
At 29 years old, carefree Hiroto Ikuta doesn't have a girlfriend, a full-time job, or a plan for the future—and he couldn't be happier. Hiroto's breezy attitude isn't easy for everyone to understand, though. In a world filled with anxiety, confusion, and grief, Hiroto and the people who surround him are all just doing their best to figure out this thing called life.
After developing an unlikely friendship with the grouchy old woman who lives in his neighborhood, Hiroto suddenly finds himself inheriting not just her house but some rather difficult emotions as well. His 18-year-old cousin, Natsumi, moves in with him, but as a struggling art student, she has her own troubles to deal with and may just put Hiroto's easygoing lifestyle to the test.
The anime will premiere in January 2027 in Japan on the NHK General channel.

Thankfully, plenty of single-season anime sidestep this particular issue by bringing something meaningful with every episode. Some of the best single-season anime have no awkward episodes or quality drops that feel jarring.
The best part about single-season anime is their compact yet satisfying storylines. From psychological horror to moving romances and even intense sports, some anime have proven that they don’t need multiple seasons to leave an impact on their viewers.

Here’s how DC describes the forthcoming new direction for Harley’s ongoing adventures:
Starer and Ketner are taking Harley from Brooklyn to France in a new story that finds her living with two terrible roommates, traveling abroad with a forged Justice League ID, assembling an unlikely crew of super-powered individuals, and attempting the most Harley Quinn-esque caper imaginable: stealing the Mona Lisa from the Louvre. And as if that isn’t enough trouble, an international cadre of assassins is after Harley’s head.
Before Harley can take Paris, however, Harley Quinn #71 has some unfinished business closer to home, including haunting childhood memories, an adult bat mitzvah, and one very important question: If you invite Batman to a bat mitzvah, does he have to show up?

Tekken 8 Game Streams Roger Jr. Starter Guide
posted on 2026-11-10 19:00 EST by Anita Tai
Season 3 character launches in early access on November 11
Bandai Namco Entertainment started streaming a starter guide video for Roger Jr., one of the characters for the Tekken 8 fighting game's Season 3, on Tuesday ahead of the character's early access release on Wednesday.
The character will be available for early access on November 11, and will launch officially on November 16.
Other Season 3 characters include Kunimitsu, Bob, and Yūjirō Hanma, the father of protagonist Baki Hanma from the Baki manga and anime series. Kunimitsu launched on June 2 in Japan and June 1 in the United States. The character launched on Early Access on May 28 in Japan and May 27 in the U.S. Bob was released for early access on August 19, and was officially released on August 24. Yūjirō Hanma will debut in early 2027.
Season 2 added Anna Williams in March 2025, Fahkumram in July 2025, Armor King in October 2025, and Miary Zo in Roger Jr. Roger Jr. early access begins on November 11, 2026 for Season 3 Character Pass holders Full release for all players follows on November 16, 2026 Season

SSS-Class Revival Hunter A mysterious tower crawling with monsters has suddenly appeared, drawing Hunters willing to risk their lives for glory and riches. Gongja Kim, a weak F-rank Hunter, spends his days envying the Flame Emperor who reigns as the top Hunter. But his chance at greatness finally arrives when he joins forces with the Sword Emperor and gains a rare S-rank skill, with one catch: he must die to activate it.
The anime stars:
Takeo Ōtsuka as Gongja Kim (listed as Yeon-ja Kim on the anime's website)
The anime will debut in January on Fuji TV's +Ultra programming block. Crunchyroll will stream the anime worldwide, excluding Asia, with availability in the Indian subcontinent, Indonesia, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia.
The original novel debuted in November 2018, and the webtoon launched in December 2020. Tapas publishes the webtoon in English digitally, and Ize Press is releasing the series in print. WuxiaWorldpublishes the web novel in English.

publication_fingerprints.headline: Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box The anime adaptation of Tomoko Ninomiya’s Nanatsu-ya: Shinobu and Her Jewelry Box has been officially announced for 2027. A teaser visual, teaser trailer, and the main staff were revealed alongside the announcement.
The main staff includes:
- Director: Chiaki Kon
- Series Composition: Seishi Minakami
- Character Design: Mai Furuki
- Animation Production: J.C.STAFF
Kon previously directed Nodame Cantabile: Paris Arc and Nodame Cantabile Finale, while J.C.STAFF also produced the Nodame Cantabile anime adaptations.
Director Chiaki Kon commented:
I’m grateful to have the opportunity to be involved in Tomoko Ninomiya-sensei’s work once again.
The stories that unfold from gemstones are truly fascinating.
I’m going to enjoy bringing these gemstone stories to life beautifully in anime for you all, so I hope you will do your best at watching. 
Tomoko Ninomiya is also the creator of Nodame Cantabile, which received the 2004 Kodansha Manga Award for shojo manga. You can see the creator’s commemorative illustration for the new anime announcement below.

Behind the Mask II: The Return of Leslie Vernon A Nightmare on Elm Street star and revered horror legend Robert Englund is coming back to another franchise. The actor is returning for a sequel to his cult classic meta-slasher film, Behind the Mask: The Rise of Leslie Vernon, with production officially underway.
According to an update on the project shared on Instagram by actor Ben Pace, production has started in Illinois on Behind the Mask II: The Return of Leslie Vernon. Its production is starting two decades after the first installment was released in 2006. The sequel rolling its cameras comes after a crowdfunding campaign was launched to help fund the new movie, when it was announced that Englund was among the returning stars also coming back.
Robert Englund Returns in the Leslie Vernon Sequel
In the 2006 film, Robert Englund played Doc Halloran. The character had a limited presence in the original, but is expected to be a more substantial part of the sequel. Nathan Baesel also returns as the titular Leslie Vernon, while Angela Goethals reprises her role as Taylor Gentry. Scott Glasserman is back in the director's chair, while writer David J. Stieve also returned to pen the screenplay.

Children of Blood and Bone is a movie based on the hit 2018 YA fantasy novel by Tomi Adeyemi. That book spawned two sequels -- Children of Virtue and Vengeance and Children of Anguish and Anarchy.
Children of Blood and Bone Gets New Trailer
Children of Blood and Bone introduces audiences to the epic fantasy world of Orïsha. In the story, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. She and her brother ally with the daughter and son of the king to fight back against his brutal rule.
The Children of Blood and Bone book's synopsis goes into more dramatic detail: "Zélie Adebola remembers when the soil of Orïsha hummed with magic. Burners ignited flames, Tiders beckoned waves, and Zélie’s Reaper mother summoned forth souls. But everything changed the night magic disappeared. Under the orders of a ruthless king, maji were killed, leaving Zélie without a mother and her people without hope.

Fine Young Cannibals' Roland Gift's Comic Based On His BBC Clash Drama
The Fine Young Cannibals' Roland Gift has written a comic based on his BBC drama, drawn by Gareth Sleightholme, debuting it at Thought Bubble
Article Summary
- Fine Young Cannibals singer Roland Gift has adapted his BBC Radio 4 drama A Punk's Progress into a new comic.
- Artist Gareth Sleightholme of Iron Shot Ape Comics joins Gift on the adaptation, debuting it at Thought Bubble.
- A Punk's Progress follows Gift's teen journey through the late-70s punk scene, sparked by a Clash concert encounter.
- Roland Gift and Gareth Sleightholme will sell the comic at Thought Bubble's 2000 AD Hall, table B32, in Harrogate.
Roland Gift is the former lead singer of Fine Young Cannibals and has also acted in films such as Scandal, Sammy And Rosie Get Laid, and played Xavier St. Cloud on Highlander: The Series. publication_fingerprints.headline: Lulumiru BL Webtoon Platform
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Lulumiru BL Webtoon Platform Kakao Piccoma, the Japanese subsidiary of Kakao, announced on November 5 it has launched a new webtoon platform titled Lulumiru. The webtoon platform focuses only on boys-love content, and is currently inaccessible outside of Japan.
The service is available on web browsers on smartphones, tablets, and PCs. Membership is free and readers can purchase works chapter by chapter. Lulumiru hosts both new series and older series that have had lasting popularity.
The service also has a search function that lets users omit certain characteristics and tags that they do not like, and also a "top x bottom" search function that allows users to choose certain characteristics they want to see in each member of a romantic pairing.
Kakao Piccoma is hosting large-scale advertisements for the new service in Ikebukuro in Tokyo from November 9 through November 22.
Kakao Piccoma currently operates the Piccoma service in Japan, which offers webtoons, web manga, and web novels.
The new Lulumiru service launches less than two months since Kakao Entertainmentannounced in late September it would shut down its North American webtoon platform Tapas, marking the end a major part of its direct platform strategy Kakao Piccoma has launched Lulumiru, a new BL‑focused webtoon service in Japan. publication_fingerprints.event_text: DC Movie Franchises That Ended Despite Sequel Plans Image courtesy of Warner Bros. Pictures The DCU has changed forever, as James Gunn and Peter Safran have been removed as the heads of DC Studios. Paramount’s acquisition of Warner Bros. and the company’s rebranding as Skydance has caused a lot of shakeup in the movie studio sphere, with Jeremy Latcham being the new chief creative officer of DC Studios. Gunn […] Several DC film series have been abruptly halted despite having sequels in development, highlighting the franchise’s volatility. The Flash (2023) earned $271.4 million on a $220 million budget and its planned sequel was cancelled after poor reception. Black Adam (2022) grossed $393.5 million against a $260 million budget, leading to the cancellation of Black Adam 2 and related crossovers. Superman IV (1987) made $36.7 million on a $17 million budget, prompting the abandonment of the planned Superman Reborn sequel.

Furious Redbrow Dark Horse Comics has announced Furious Redbrow, a new three-issue fantasy series by Ben Stenbeck, set in Stenbeck and Mike Mignola‘s Lands Unknown universe. Building on Stenbeck’s 2026 series The Skinless Man, the comic will introduce readers to the barbarian Redbrow, who’ll become known in the years to come as the God-Killer.
The official synopsis reminds readers that in the prior series, “a mysterious old Warrior and his animal companions hear[d] a chilling tale from a witch. But who was this man, the one the witch called God-Killer? Where did he come from and what was it that he sought? Now the God-Killer takes center stage as Furious Redbrow finally reveals Redbrow, son of Whitedog, blessed by the spider woman, and raised to kill all monsters.”
“I introduced the weathered old man Redbrow in The Skinless Man,” says Stenbeck. “Now, I’m going back to his youth and the world he grew up in far off to the west of Lands Unknown. A savage unforgiving place to live, for man or beast.” The book will also feature colors and lettering by respective stalwart Mignola collaborators Dave Stewart and Clem Robins.

Charlie Adlard Swaps Walking Dead For Talking Sheep In His New Comic
Benjamin Dickson and Charlie Adlard's new comic, The Mountains Belong To Us, debuts with free previews at Thought Bubble
Article Summary
- Charlie Adlard swaps The Walking Dead for talking sheep in The Mountains Belong To Us, a new 2027 comic with Benjamin Dickson.
- The story follows a young woman who loses her father, joins a shepherd, and inherits his flock when war pulls him away.

Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Gonbe Shinkawa's Uzono Shiniko Hōkoku (Uzono Shiniko Report) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 7.
The manga is about the informal investigation carried out by the Japanese government, the military, investigative agencies, and ordinary citizens since 1892, about the strange phenomena called "Uzono Shiniko." It is said that if a human, animal, or any inanimate object's name is changed to "Uzono Shiniko," it suddenly attracts disaster.
Shinkawa launched the series on Kadokawa's ComicWalker manga website in December 2024. The manga is an adaptation of Bunkichi Majima's novel of the same title. Asahiro Kakashi is credited for the manga's storyboard composition.

Matt Reeves' 2022 film The Batman was one of the most beloved DC projects of the past decade. It became the third-highest-grossing Batman film of all time, and it was praised by critics and general audiences alike. Though many were initially skeptical that former Twilight star Robert Pattinson could effectively portray the Caped Crusader, he gave a strong performance that won over most naysayers.
The Batman Part II entered development in 2022, but the sequel has been slow to gestate, and it is not scheduled to be released until early 2028. Grendel Though it may seem inconceivable, Matt Wagner’s acclaimed character and series Grendel has yet to be adapted for film or television. More than forty years after the character’s debut in comics, it was officially announced that Netflix has ordered a Grendel animated series with Bobak Esfarjani (Widow’s Bay, WandaVision, Alien: Earth) involved as writer, executive producer and showrunner
First debuting in 1982 in the pages of Comico Primer #2, the character quickly gained his own title. Following the bankruptcy of original publisher Comico, the characters and series languished in limbo for some time before finding a new publishing home at Dark Horse Comics and has remained there ever since.
A quick primer for those unfamiliar with the series:
After the woman he loves is shockingly murdered, Hunter Rose devotes himself to one thing: vengeance. But as he tears through street gangs, the elite, and New York City’s supernatural underworld in pursuit of her killer, a chance at a real life forces him to choose: walk away from ultimate power, or become the very monster he hunts.
In addition Esfarjani, other executive producers for the Grendel animated series include Chris Tongue, Tim Wiesch Netflix has officially ordered an animated series adaptation of Matt Wagner’s comic Grendel. publication_fingerprints.headline: Chiruran Manga Gets New Stage Play by All-Female Troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue
publication_fingerprints.event_text:
Chiruran Manga Gets New Stage Play by All-Female Troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue The all-female troupe O'Clock Kumamoto Revue (also known as 096k Kumamoto Revue) announced on Friday that they will produce a new stage play based on Eiji Hashimoto and Shinya Umemura's Chiruran: Shinsengumi Requiem (Chiruran: Shinsengumi Chinkon-ka) manga in early summer 2027.
Original author Umemura is writing the script. Hajime Kikuchi is directing the new play.
The manga inspired a previous stage play adaptation that ran in April 2017.
Titan Mangalicensed the manga for release as 3-in-1 omnibus editions, and it describes the story:
Before he became the legendary Vice Commander of the feared Shinsengumi, Hijikata Toshizou was a reckless young swordsman determined to carve out his place in a nation on the brink of collapse. As political unrest tears Japan apart and violence erupts in the streets of Kyoto, Toshizou and his comrades will forge the Shinsengumi, the ruthless “Mibu Wolves”, a band of warriors sworn to restore order at any cost.
Umemura provided the story, and Hashimoto illustrated the manga. The duo launched the series in the inaugural issue of Tokuma Shoten's Monthly Comic Zenon magazine in 2010. The manga began its final arc with the 32nd compiled book volume in Jan The manga Chiruran will be adapted into a new stage play written by original author Umemura and directed by Hajime Kikuc

Aria the Scarlet Ammo Corto Kadokawa revealed on Sunday the key visual, returning and new cast members, main staff, and April 2027 streaming debut for Hidan no Aria Corto (Aria the Scarlet AmmoCorto), the new short anime commemorating the 15th anniversary of the Aria the Scarlet Ammo anime series.
The new anime is set in Gakuen-shima (Academy Island), where Aria and Kinji are confronted with the crisis of drones and robots going on a rampage, upon their return to Japan from solving cases around the world.
The anime adaptation of the original Aria the Scarlet Ammo (Hidan no Aria) novels debuted in Japan in 2011. Funimationstreamed the anime as it aired, and released it on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in 2012.
Kadokawa will publish the original novels' 46th volume on December 25. Yoshino Koyoka has been drawing a manga adaptation of the novels in Kadokawa's Monthly Comic Alive magazine since 2009, and Kadokawa published the 26th compiled book volume in February 2025. Digital Manga Inc. previously released three volumes of the manga digitally. The series has over 9 million copies in circulation.
